test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Sound made by ducks
solution:
The correct answer is **Quack**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Quack: **​the sound that a duck makes.

 
 
• **Example: **People could hear the ducks **quacking**. 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Moo: **the characteristic deep call of cattle.
 
• **Caw: **the harsh cry of a rook, crow, or similar bird.
 
• **Grunt: t**he sound made by camels.
